subject: FY24 Budget Recommendations
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to discuss and formalize Council priorities for the upcoming fiscal year 2024 budget to be submitted to the Mayor.

items.title: Council Recommendations for the FY24 Budget
items.summary: The committee discussed and approved submitting a formal list of priorities to the Mayor, including requests for a dedicated Budget Director, funding for phase two of zoning recodification, and full funding for the public schools and library.
